NAVIGATION MENU

Annual leave

Employees who have worked for at least 3 months are entitled to paid annual leave each year.

How much leave

The minimum entitlement depends on your years of service with the employer.

  • Leave is pro-rated for part years
  • Unused leave may be paid out
